name: Date Range Picker
description: A two-click range field with presets and a keyboard-navigable calendar popover.

anatomy.description: The trigger showing the formatted start and end pair.
Buttons that fill common windows like the last week or month.
The two-click month grid with keyboard navigation.
Buttons that mark the range start, end, and the span between.

dos: Offer presets when users repeatedly pick the same windows.
Disable dates that cannot join the range, like weekends for maintenance windows.
Let two clicks define the range; don't force a drag gesture.
donts: Don't use it for a single date; use DatePicker.
Don't allow inverted ranges; the component orders the start before the end.
Don't hide the selected span; the in-range highlight is the feedback.

examples.title: Range selection
examples.description: The first click starts the range and the second completes it; presets fill common windows.

examples.title: Disabled days
examples.description: isDateDisabled blocks weekends so only weekday windows can be picked.

examples.title: Bounded ranges
examples.description: Use isDateDisabled to exclude days such as weekends or past dates.

guidance.useWhen: The user picks a start and end date.
guidance.avoidWhen: Only one date is needed; use DatePicker.
guidance.behavior: Two clicks define the range; presets fill common windows and arrows move by day or week.
guidance.responsive: The popover collision-handles; the field keeps its layout width.

keyboard.action: Opens the calendar from the field.
Moves the focused day by one day.
Moves the focused day by one week.
Picks the range start, then the range end.

notes: Day buttons use a roving tab index, so the calendar grid is a single Tab stop.
Range start and end days expose their state through aria-pressed, and today keeps aria-current date.
Preset buttons fill the whole range in one action and are plain buttons in the tab order.
The month label is announced with aria-live as the view changes.
